issues.explanation: New mention validation and truncation-reservation behavior ships without any Pest/PHPUnit test, violating the no-production-code-without-a-test rule.

conventions.evidence: .env.example:9-10, config/services.php:96, docs/ops/devops.md:109,117, docs/ops/logging.md:129, CHANGELOG.md:22 docs kept in sync; stays in App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert with no new layers; sibling style with private helpers, mb_substr, config()

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:54-85 small focused mentionId() with docblock, clear names (mentionId, available, suffix), consistent style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:43-51 suffix "\n"+"<@id>" with reserve-truncate to 1800; :39-40 null/invalid returns bare mb_substr; :75,80 trim + /^[0-9]{17,20}$/ rejects @everyone/@here/abc/123/newlines; config/services.php:96 mention_id from DISCORD_MENTION_ID; .env.example:10 + docs/ops/devops.md:117 + docs/ops/logging.md:129

scope.evidence: All hunks serve the task: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, .env.example, docs/ops/devops.md, docs/ops/logging.md, CHANGELOG.md; no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:80 anchored /^[0-9]{17,20}$/ after trim blocks @everyone, @here, short numbers and embedded-newline payloads; no secrets, escaping, or Livewire concerns

simplicity.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:36-85 minimal ~30-line addition reusing formatContent/config/preg_match; no abstractions, no duplication

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no test files; new mentionId validation, no-mention case, and mention-preserving truncation have zero Pest/PHPUnit coverage

review.summary: Adds DISCORD_MENTION_ID ping with strict snowflake validation and mention-preserving 1800-char truncation, plus env/docs updates. Correct and well-scoped, but ships with no tests despite the project requiring tests for every feature, so it needs changes before merging.
